Four more of ext-zlib's surface, and the last of it that does not need incremental compression
state. They frame BYTES rather than serve a stream, so they sit beside the `gz*` stream family in
the same prelude — a program naming any of them gets the whole thing, and one that names none
carries nothing.

Nothing here re-implements compression. MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6:
